bands.rule: all 24 rows complete with no error row
rows changing any criterion other than A2 (implementation failure)
rows gaining a new critical committed-secret finding that is not a genuine committed credential
rows changing A2 score, status, or secret_scan finding count/kind
rows changing overall, code-trust or process-trust score
rows losing a committed-secret finding v22 reported that hand review confirms is genuine
